node_policy: Retain every assigned neuronal superclass, including uncertain neuronal classes; exclude explicit glia and unassigned segmentation objects. Do not require Traced status or a cell type.
edge_policy: All positive released contacts between retained neurons; no additional confidence/contact threshold; preserve autapses; merge repeated directed pairs by summing contact counts.
sign_policy_note: Exploratory current-based single-sign-per-neuron approximation, not measured receptor-specific polarity. Zero means unsupported fast transmission, not a missing anatomical edge. Modulatory transmission requires a separate validated model.
